name: GreenGeeks
tagline: Renewable-energy-matched cPanel hosting with free nightly backups
description: GreenGeeks is a cPanel-based web hosting provider known for matching its power use with renewable energy credits, running on LiteSpeed servers, and including free nightly backups on every shared hosting plan.
about: GreenGeeks' shared hosting comes in three tiers: Lite (1 website, 25GB SSD storage), Pro (unlimited websites, 50GB SSD storage), and Premium (unlimited websites, 100GB SSD storage, dedicated IP). All three run on standard cPanel, include unmetered bandwidth, a free CDN, free Let's Encrypt SSL, free nightly backups, and a free domain for the first year on annual or longer terms.

Introductory pricing on the lowest term runs $2.95/month (Lite), $4.95/month (Pro) or $8.95/month (Premium) — but renews at $13.95, $18.95 and $30.95 per month respectively once the initial term ends. That's roughly a 3-4x jump at renewal, among the steeper increases in budget shared hosting, so it's worth budgeting for the renewal rate rather than the headline price before signing up for a long initial term.
policies: GreenGeeks backs its hosting plans with a 30-day money-back guarantee.

faqs.q: Is GreenGeeks actually a green/renewable-energy host?
faqs.a: GreenGeeks says it purchases renewable energy credits equal to 300% of the power its platform draws from the grid, through the Bonneville Environmental Foundation, and has partnered with One Tree Planted on tree-planting initiatives. The hosting itself still runs on standard grid electricity — the environmental claim is about offsetting via credits, not off-grid power.
Yes — all GreenGeeks shared hosting plans run on the industry-standard cPanel control panel, so the interface will be familiar if you've used other cPanel-based hosts.

faqs.q: Is GreenGeeks' advertised price what I'll pay on renewal?
faqs.a: No. GreenGeeks' lowest prices are introductory for the first term only. Shared hosting renews at $13.95/month (Lite), $18.95/month (Pro) or $30.95/month (Premium) — noticeably higher than the sign-up price, so factor the renewal cost into your decision rather than just the discounted rate.

faqs.q: Does GreenGeeks offer a money-back guarantee?
faqs.a: Yes — GreenGeeks backs its plans with a 30-day money-back guarantee, so you can request a refund if it's not a good fit.

faqs.q: Does GreenGeeks include a free domain?
faqs.a: Yes, GreenGeeks's plans include a free domain registration for the first year. It reverts to the standard renewal price after that.

faqs.q: Does GreenGeeks include a free CDN?
faqs.a: Yes, GreenGeeks bundles a free CDN with its plans to help speed up page loads for visitors worldwide.

faqs.q: Do I need a promo code to get GreenGeeks's best price?
faqs.a: Not always — some GreenGeeks deals apply automatically at checkout, while others require pasting a revealed code into the promo/coupon field before you pay. Check each listing above for details.

faqs.q: How do I get started with GreenGeeks?
faqs.a: Pick a plan that fits your needs on GreenGeeks's website, complete checkout, and your account is usually ready within minutes.

faqs.q: Is GreenGeeks good value for hosting?
faqs.a: GreenGeeks is one of the more popular hosting providers — compare its plans and any current deal above against your specific needs before committing.

faqs.q: Can I cancel my GreenGeeks plan anytime?
faqs.a: Most GreenGeeks plans can be cancelled from your account dashboard; check GreenGeeks's own terms for any minimum-term or refund conditions that apply to your plan.
